Please, help me get some rest!

desc:

desc:
"Remnants of a Gunblade"

Before you stands the mighty Demi-God Draegar, a wretched being, a prisoner within a mechanical throne. Impaled into the icy surface was the blood stained remnants of a Gunblade all too familiar to you. There was no sign of the shaggy mercernary anywhere… just you and a very very angry War Machine of Death.

raw.vi:
"A Request from an Old Doctor"
My wife was a Summoner, you see. It was about time for her to retire, but she refused saying that she still had what it took, and made quite a fuss. There was a terrifying demon in the snow fields...hmm...5 years ago or so? What's the point, you ask? Well, you know where I'm going with this, don't you? Please defeat that demon before my wife gets there! By the way, she's in intensive training right now.

The mysterious appearance of the floating land masses and the giant rift tear poses a threat to the stability and safety of the region. All abled Summoners are to investigate, pinpoint the cause and close the rift.

"Perintah Misi dari Zenia"
Yang ini mengingat tanah ini saat masih suar berkilau cahaya, simbol perdamaian dan semua yang kita perjuangkan untuk dicapai. Sangat indah untuk dilihat. Sangat menyakitkan sekarang melihatnya terbakar dan menjadi puing-puing. Lembah dan jalan-jalan yang tadinya tempat bermain kini penuh monster, baik robot manusia atau bukan. Maukah kau membantu yang ini mengalahkan minion Gazia dari rumahku?

desc: "Mission orders from Zenia This one remembers this land when it was a shining beacon of light, a symbol of peace and all we worked to achieved. It was a beautiful sight to behold. Will you aid this one in ousting Gazia’s minions from my home?

desc:

"A Request from Akras Summoners' Hall"
This is a private request due to extreme circumstances. Ishgrian demons have come into conflict in the mountain regions. They seem to be tearing into each other, but will eliminate all Grand Gaian life if left to themselves. Enter the battle as soon as possible and be absolutely certain to eliminate them one by one.
